scope: Business management v2, trusted prepared checkout, cold import/full directory rollback and isolated real offline Rust delivery; full business and production replacement incomplete

dependencies.operators: Python standard library + installed systemd; no new Rust/JS library

formal_product.environment: Formal executable + actual Native/CodingToolBundle/SQL/Driver/Outbox; only model/GitHub/Feishu transport endpoints are explicit offline fixtures
new_behaviors: Trusted fixed repository HTTPS clone into private staging, expected HEAD comparison, credential-free whole .git/config rewrite, atomic publication; moved base/cancellation cleanups and no re-clone on reopen. Clone timeout300s/API90s.
Management search/thread timeline/decision/policy history/labels/Prompt history; account preflight without failed-setting commit; controlled join-before-restart on save or setup/check.
Bounded oversized HTTP body discard preserves structured400 and unchanged accepting/mutation limit.
Standalone immutable schema11 cold import preserves observed IDs/cursors/settings/settled receipts, refuses outstanding work and does not continue legacy DSH sessions.
Full multi-object directory snapshot/hash verification/restore; old trees retained outside runtime session scanning with same-filesystem quarantines.
inspect.checkout now reflects trusted checkout configuration, not a newly asserted Git state after Worker access.

recovery_findings: Original Node24 MainThread command name misclassified by its existing controller; owned exact-executable/cwd compatibility wrapper, no original source change.
Old Source child outlived controller stop; bounded PID+start-time-witness cleanup before snapshot.
Read-only SQLite could create WAL/SHM in backup; immutable standalone snapshot fix and no-sidecars assertion.
Sibling prior-session copies broke legacy scanner identity; retained outside scanning root and corrected restore tool.

real_C1.network_route: V100 direct GitHub and its existing local proxy were unhealthy. A temporary loopback-only SSH reverse route reused the Mac existing proxy, with HTTPS/TLS verification; no host DNS/firewall/key changes, no agent forwarding. It is not a durable server-only production route.
real_C1.worker_network: existing deny; no environment credentials injected
real_C1.model_missteps_retained: Ordinary gh auth/API probes failed; missing directories and absolute write paths were refused before corrected relative writes. These are real errors, not successful tool calls.

post_timebox_followup.followup_scope: Only read existing PR/checks/reviews, preserve CI failures, report actual ready with7; no second publish/PR or dependency installation

regressions_and_failures.workspace_16: Failed at two pre-existing V100 legacy Feishu deployment assertions: dedicated UID1007 and whitelist iptables; not bypassed or changed. Earlier targets passed but remaining targets did not run.
regressions_and_failures.ci_42: macOS all gates passed; Ubuntu failed new checkout build output assertion. Selected system Python plus actual written build-proof assertion revealed real CI sandbox unavailable; no removed test or assertion. Packaged per-binary AppArmor setup and mandatory real probe added for the ephemeral CI runner only.
regressions_and_failures.ci_79: Ubuntu disk exhausted compiling full test binaries; macOS run later cancelled on new base push. CI-only debug-info/incremental limits and fresh cache prefix added, no tests removed.
regressions_and_failures.c1_PR7_CI: Ubuntu actual isolation probe unavailable (RTM_NEWADDR EPERM), not merely Python; Mac Feishu consumer recovery test raced final fixture response with SIGTERM and got Broken pipe. Packaged AppArmor profile preflight is now explicit CI-only; final-request barrier added only to that test, all old assertions retained. Neither fix is pre-signed-off by old CI.
regressions_and_failures.current_exact_head_CI: pending separate run; not signed off by a previous green commit
regressions_and_failures.product_17: New inspect-result assertion counted the same replayed tool result twice. Corrected to count unique tool-call identities; original failure retained.

remaining: Genuine human Feishu task -> real Worker -> real reply remains without machine-verifiable external evidence; user does not need to resend a test and no bot-authored event is relabeled human.
v1 delivery remains a bounded immutable UTF-8 snapshot, not arbitrary binary/delete/exec/history or repeated review-branch updates.
Stable server-only GitHub egress must be repaired before unattended production; Mac temporary tunnel is a validation route only.

No all-six production cutover, full live-traffic rollback/external side-effect reconciliation, active Worker/SSH SIGKILL matrix, complete reference management/UI interaction or all23 business-group signoff.

Existing generic process sandbox exposes host filesystem read-only. Environment credential scrubbing is verified; this is not proof of file-based credential isolation. Restricting autonomous production file visibility remains a separate gate.
